purpose: Bind the sanitized v4 source snapshot, module dossiers, release evidence, and claim boundaries into one deterministic Merkle manifest.
excludedMaterial: logs, caches, secrets, model weights, and publish outputs
verification: Every dossier identity matches its manifest entry
Two independent manifest generations produce the same release root
A temporary clean clone on S: reproduces the solution build, synchronized self-tests, property report, and release root
claimBoundary: Integrity tool only; it does not promote research approval or CNS claims.
